exit_policies.original: Current deadline/ST/entry-minus3ATR stop; no profit exit.
exit_policies.fixed_profit_3atr: Completed adjusted close>=actual adjusted entry fill+3entryATR requests full exit; original3ATR stop retained.
exit_policies.trailing_profit_2_1_5atr: Only completed adjusted closes since actual entry may form the peak; peak>=entry+2entryATR arms protection, close<=peak-1.5entryATR requests full exit; original3ATR stop retained. Never use pre-entry signal close as a held peak.

protocol.exit_execution: Decide from completed D close, execute earliest tradable D+1 open proxy after T+1; new profit requests persist if execution blocked. Deadline then ST then original stop retain priority. No intraday high/low touch fills, same-day sell, perfect limit fill or forced deadline liquidation.
protocol.cost_basis: Reuse historical date-dependent commission, minimum fee, transfer fee, stamp tax and10bp per-side proxy slippage; double scenario doubles all costs. Report proxy mismatch to current live fees explicitly.
protocol.delay: One-session delay of frozen qualification/ranking and entry-condition source date, while current completed eligibility and tradability still gate entry; exit observes latest completed held day. Same for controls and candidates.
protocol.selection: Select one of the3 exits by2020-2021 continuous net_return_pct-2*max_drawdown_pct with>=20completed cycles; original wins ties. Do not change parameters or switch to a later-history winner.
